purpose: Freeze the intrinsic language/design metrics that cannot be reduced to direct execution measurements. The LLM classifies evidence into fixed component levels; the runner owns all arithmetic. Ecosystem maturity, popularity and present-day adoption are explicitly out of scope.

level_definitions.0: Absent, fundamentally hostile to the criterion, or contradicted by the language/runtime's normal documented semantics.
level_definitions.1: Rudimentary or high-friction: possible only through substantial ceremony, weak guarantees, ad-hoc conventions, or major semantic caveats.
level_definitions.2: Usable baseline capability with meaningful limitations, ambiguity, ceremony, or gaps that ordinary users must manage.
level_definitions.3: Strong, predictable and idiomatic capability with only moderate limitations or clearly bounded tradeoffs.
level_definitions.4: First-class, explicit and low-friction design for the criterion, with strong guarantees and no material intrinsic gap under the frozen scope.

scoring.metric_score_formula: sum(level_points[component_level]) across the five fixed components; range 0..100

source_priority: language specification / official language reference present in the frozen inputs
documented standard/runtime semantics present in the frozen inputs
mechanically observed diagnostics or behavior already present in readable evidence
evidence_policy.symmetry_rule: Use the same five components, generic level definitions and intrinsic-language boundary for every language. Do not reward language age, community size, package count, editor maturity, production adoption, or realized platform breadth; those belong to Ecosystem.
evidence_policy.source_size_boundary: Code Efficiency / Conciseness evaluates mandatory ceremony and semantic work per construct, not raw bytes/LOC/tokens; raw source size is already a separate runner-owned metric and must not be counted twice.
evidence_policy.diagnostics_boundary: Diagnostics evaluates the language/compiler/runtime diagnostic design exposed by normal use. Debugging-tool product maturity belongs to Ecosystem, while adversarial detection outcomes and Debuggability remain runner-owned Language Quality safety metrics.
evidence_policy.na_rule: A capability intentionally tested by a component is not N/A merely because the language lacks it; score the absence through the rubric. Use N/A only under the benchmark-wide genuine-inapplicability rule.

metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic mandatory ceremony for the same kinds of ordinary programs. Do not reuse raw LOC/bytes/tokens as the score and do not reward external libraries.

components.criterion: Routine variables, functions, parameters and returns can be expressed without disproportionate mandatory boilerplate.
Common control flow and collection/data manipulation avoid repetitive structural ceremony unrelated to the algorithm.
Reusable abstractions such as types, interfaces/traits/generics or equivalent mechanisms can be declared and consumed without excessive scaffolding.
Ordinary error/resource handling expresses intent without pervasive mandatory boilerplate while retaining clear semantics.
Idiomatic source spends most syntax on domain/algorithm meaning rather than language-mandated plumbing; this is a qualitative ceremony judgment, not a second source-size measurement.

metric.readability.selection_rule: Judge readability of idiomatic code under the frozen corpus and documented syntax/semantics, without inventing human-study results.

components.criterion: A local expression/statement makes its operation and important effects reasonably apparent without unrelated context.
Blocks, declarations, calls and data construction have visually and syntactically clear structure.
Similar concepts use regular forms with few special-case spellings or context-dependent surface rules.
The language permits names/types/signatures to communicate intent without forcing distracting noise or hiding essential information.
Control flow, mutation and exceptional/effectful behavior can be followed from ordinary idiomatic source with bounded cognitive indirection.

metric.functionality_expressiveness.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic general-purpose expressive power available in the language/core runtime, not third-party package breadth.

components.criterion: The language can model structured data and domain variants/invariants with practical first-class constructs.
Functions, modules/types and generic/polymorphic abstraction support reusable composition across ordinary programs.
The language supports practical higher-order/compositional programming patterns where applicable without unnatural escape hatches.
The language exposes sufficient control over execution, resources, errors and interoperability for its claimed general-purpose scope.
Major language features compose predictably rather than becoming unavailable or fragile when used together.

metric.diagnostics.selection_rule: Judge built-in compiler/checker/runtime diagnostic design from normal language use; do not count external IDE/debugger maturity.

components.criterion: Diagnostics identify the relevant source location and enough local context to find the failing construct.
Diagnostics distinguish meaningful error categories/root causes instead of collapsing failures into generic messages.
Type/value/syntax contract failures report useful expected-versus-actual information or an equivalent precise explanation.
Diagnostics expose stable structured codes/categories or otherwise predictable forms suitable for tooling and automated reasoning.
Messages normally provide enough precise information to correct the issue without requiring unrelated guesswork; suggested fixes count only when semantically reliable.

metric.dependency_simplicity.selection_rule: Judge language/module dependency semantics and intrinsic project dependency model. Registry size, package-manager maturity and community conventions belong to Ecosystem.

components.criterion: Module/import semantics are small, explicit and predictable from source.
Ordinary dependency/name resolution has deterministic, documented precedence with limited ambient search-path surprises.
Direct dependencies can be declared explicitly at an appropriate project/module boundary rather than inferred from ambient state.
The language/project model provides clear namespace/version/isolation boundaries that reduce accidental coupling.
Transitive dependency visibility and import exposure are controlled and understandable rather than silently leaking arbitrary dependencies.

metric.portability_design_platform_neutr.selection_rule: Judge the language/runtime design for writing portable source. Actual number of currently implemented targets belongs to Ecosystem.

components.criterion: Core language semantics avoid unnecessary dependence on one OS/CPU/ABI and specify portable behavior for ordinary constructs.
Core/standard runtime interfaces provide portable abstractions for common OS/runtime needs with explicit platform escape hatches.
Primitive data/numeric behavior needed for portable programs is sufficiently specified across targets, with implementation-defined behavior clearly bounded.
When platform-specific behavior is necessary, the language/project model exposes explicit, localized conditional mechanisms rather than implicit divergence.
Source-level program meaning is not unnecessarily tied to a single compiler ABI, filesystem convention or host-specific build assumption.

metric.ffi_interoperability_design.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic FFI/ABI boundary design, not breadth of existing third-party bindings (Ecosystem).

components.criterion: Foreign symbols/functions/types can be declared or imported with explicit, understandable boundary syntax.
ABI/calling-convention/linkage choices are explicit or safely standardized for common interoperability cases.
Primitive/aggregate/string/pointer or equivalent boundary representations have clear mapping rules and layout control where needed.
Ownership, lifetime, allocation and error responsibilities across the foreign boundary can be expressed explicitly enough to avoid hidden hazards.
Embedding, callbacks/function pointers or equivalent bidirectional interoperation are supported by a coherent language design rather than only bespoke glue.

metric.concurrency.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic concurrency/parallelism semantics and core runtime primitives. External frameworks and debugger/tool maturity are out of scope.

components.criterion: The normal language/runtime model supports genuine parallel execution for applicable workloads without a fundamental default bottleneck or undocumented caveat.
Asynchronous concurrency has first-class composition and structured lifetime/join/cancellation mechanisms or an equivalent disciplined model.
Core primitives for synchronization/message passing/shared-state coordination are coherent, documented and practical.
The language provides strong static or runtime mechanisms to prevent/detect data races and unsafe concurrent access, with unsafe escape hatches explicit.
Errors, cancellation and task termination propagate predictably across concurrent work instead of being silently detached or lost.
